basic_info.description: Step into sophistication with this newly remodeled 1649 sq ft sanctuary in the vibrant heart of Castro. Undergoing a complete down-to-the-stud remodeling, this residence has been transformed into a masterpiece of modern design boasting 3 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms adorned with contemporary finishes with luxury tiles and venetian plastered wall, inviting you to unwind in elegance. Indulge your culinary desires in the expansive kitchen, adorned with beautiful countertops and modern appliances, including Thermador appliances throughout the kitchen including a Thermador wine cooler, perfect for entertaining guests or enjoying quiet evenings in. With its spacious layout and abundant natural light, the living and dining areas offer the ideal backdrop for hosting gatherings or simply relaxing in style with Venetian plaster fireplace. Escape to the tranquility of the bedrooms, equipped with ample storage and a custom closet system, providing a seamless blend of functionality and sophistication. Convenience is key with the inclusion of a stacked washer and dryer, separate water and PG&E meters ensuring a low HOA of $300 a month. With its move-in ready status, this exquisite property invites you to experience the epitome of modern living in one of San Francisco's most coveted neighborhood
